title: fix(subagents): avoid cleanup failures during overlapping completion
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes subagent completion failing when overlapping completion callbacks or a newer run take browser-cleanup ownership while an older callback waits to persist its cleanup claim.

## User Impact

Completed subagent work can finish without a spurious cleanup failure. The current owner retains browser cleanup; genuine persistence and authority failures remain visible. No configuration change is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Retire only the original callback's positively identified pre-commit ownership rejection. A superseded session uses the existing run-retirement path. Committed or uncertain writes and unrelated errors still propagate.

Related: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163725. The failure also reproduced without that PR's authority change.

## Evidence

- A deterministic FIFO regression failed on the unchanged base with the original owner-loss error. The final six-case suite passes, covering overlapping completion, queued and pre-commit session supersession, matching-message persistence errors, authority rejection, and unknown write outcomes.
- Six existing browser-cleanup lifecycle cases passed. The original 39-case production-boundary suite passed on the initial ownership fix; the subsequent retirement and wrapped-error corrections have focused regression coverage.
- Final native test command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/subagents/registry/subagent-registry-terminal-effects.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` — 8.67 seconds wall time, including 2.9 seconds of cached worker preparation; the six cases took 354 ms. CI seconds are pending the attached run.
- Tests exercise real controller/persistence code with an ACK transport fixture; they do not claim real SQLite transaction coverage.
- The production change has clean independent, automated P2, and ClawSweeper reviews. Independent review also cleared the final test-only lint correction. All six tests, typed lint, and repository changed checks for that correction passed; prior core/static proof remains valid. Required hosted CI and ClawSweeper verification on the updated head are pending.
